rationale: Race 10 (entityR2A, score 830.86) is the best result so far, and its geometry is the race 8 platform: five 16 mm sensors at x = -0.03 to +0.03 with y = 0.06, body 0.12 m by 0.12 m, wheel_track 0.12 m, wheel_radius 0.03 m, mass 0.8 kg. The only change in that race was the controller (kd 0.6 to 0.8, kp 3.2, base_speed 0.95). Oval finished 20/20 and s-bend 20/20, and slalom rose from 2/20 to 9/20 finishes with line loss down from 1.0 to 0.85. This satisfies the Integrator's own rule for keeping the geometry: slalom line loss fell to 0.85, below 1.0. The Integrator's wheel_track 0.10 test (race 9) lost slalom finishes, and the wheel_track revert was accepted. Mass 0.6 kg was the one open exploration. I am not running it now. This is the final iteration, and a mass change would be a new, untested platform with no further iteration to correct it, while the final unseen-track race is scored on whatever robot is produced here. Holding the best measured geometry is the lower-risk choice for that race. The Integrator may still change the controller, and slalom line loss at 0.85 is the number to watch.
